call_purpose: You had connected your payment gateway, but your customers were not getting the order confirmation email after they bought.

resolved.text: Following our guidance, you switched on the order confirmation email setting for your product and saved it.
You placed a test order with your test coupon and confirmed the order confirmation email arrived in your inbox.

covered.text: We explained that the sender name on the email can be changed under Email settings, Sender name.

customer_next_steps.text: Change the sender name to your brand name yourself.
